annotation.title_clean: Pro-innovation Regulation of Technologies Review: Digital Technologies
annotation.title_en: Pro-innovation Regulation of Technologies Review: Digital Technologies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: UK Government Chief Scientific Adviser (Sir Patrick Vallance), HM Government
annotation.summary_en: UK government-commissioned review by the Chief Scientific Adviser recommending a pro-innovation regulatory approach to digital technologies. It covers AI sandboxes, generative AI and IP, data access, and regulatory barriers for autonomous vehicles, drones, cyber security and space technologies, advocating early flexibility, experimentation, then international harmonisation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three-stage approach: early regulatory flexibility, experimentation via sandboxes/testbeds, later international harmonisation.
Establish multi-regulator AI sandbox to address fragmented regulation.
Announce clear policy on IP law and generative AI, enabling text and data mining.
Labelling of AI-generated images and watermarking standards encouraged.
Government signalling to focus regulators on innovation in autonomous vehicles, drones, cyber and space.
